project_name: AURA FIT - Virtual AR Fitting Room & Mobile Remote
archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON / ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY EDITORIAL (High Fashion Tech Mirror)

design_philosophy.core_concept: Editorial Runway meets AR Cyber-HUD. High contrast dark obsidian studio background paired with vibrant acid-gold & cyber-lime accents, tactile glassmorphism panels, raw technical typography, and fluid AR body-mesh controls.
anti_patterns: No generic Inter/Roboto typography for headers
No cramped card grids without padding
No transparent overlays without backdrop blurs
No generic 'camera off' blank screens - always show stylized camera permissions / live skeleton canvas placeholder
No missing navigation or orphan mobile screens

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none

landing_page.hero_subtitle: Experience real-time cloth warping and 3D body tracking on your laptop, controlled live via your phone.

laptop_mirror.camera_view: Fullscreen responsive AR canvas with real-time pose skeleton mesh overlay
laptop_mirror.floating_qr_panel: Glassmorphism card (backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border-border) displaying dynamic QR code to pair mobile device with token
laptop_mirror.status_bar: Live FPS counter, active pose landmark counter (33/33), sync indicator ('Phone Connected' / 'Waiting for Remote')
laptop_mirror.controls: Snapshot Capture, Toggle Skeleton, Garment Quick Swapper, Fullscreen Toggle

sections: Fit Controls Segmented Toggle (Fitted, Regular, Relaxed)
Mini Mirror Preview Feed / Canvas Thumbnail

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based identifiers for automated testing

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You have .js / .jsx files in frontend, NOT .tsx files. Follow React .js component conventions.
Do NOT use Inter font for headlines. Use Syne, Cabinet Grotesk, or font-serif for editorial punch.
Use backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent borders for all AR HUD and floating panels.
Ensure camera fallback state is stylish (e.g. animated pose skeleton graphic + camera permission prompt).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, garment cards, toggles) MUST have data-testid attributes.
Keep mobile PWA view responsive, touch-friendly, and optimized for phone screens with haptic-like button states.
